notes.title: BoneTown Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/563a6e009d38f2a3f218356741c0725243a4e794.jpg

It’s been awhile, so we thought we’d drop in and let you guys know what’s been going on. 

As you might remember, we've been updating the engine for an improved frame-rate and graphics. We have it in Beta testing right now and it’s looking good. We are trying to get you guys a few more frames before releasing it to everyone, but we are getting much closer.

The Fetish DLC is still chugging along, getting closer and closer. We're working out the kinks--pun intended--for gang-bang sex (two guys / one girl), which means we’ll have things like one girl sucking two guys' dicks, wobbly H for all girls, splitting the silk, and all the other great things two friends can do with a willing girl. 

And since we know there are people who have been waiting on this for years--we finally got gay sex in the game. We weren't sure it was going to work, but the Gay Gods shined down on us, and it'll be coming soon. (And if you're not interested, there will be a way to make sure gay sex isn't part of your gameplay--we're making the sex on BoneTown more customizable for everyone.) 

When this Fetish DLC is complete, we feel like we could be give PornHub a run for it’s money in terms of sexual variety. We can’t wait to get it to you guys, but we gotta do it right, so it’s going to be just a bit longer.

While you wait, though, there has been some other great BoneTown news. Our friends over at Shady Lewd Kart have added a BoneTown-themed level to their porn kart racer. Now you can race around a level that combines all the best parts of BoneTown in a cart based on our B1-Bonger. Shady’s been reviewing adult games since BoneTown first came out way back in 2008, and now has his own game that combines IP's from hentai games, vtubers, voice actors and mascots. It has everything, from Zonetan to Projekt Melody.

Check it out through the links below, and keep an ear out for new BoneTown news--we should have some good stuff for you in near future.

Keep up the Boning,

notes.title: Update on Progress of BoneTown
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/3e61c4ed964383d9f4c577c46c95639f09076472.jpg

It’s been a while, so we thought we’d give you guys an update on what we’ve been working on for the future of BoneTown.

First, we are getting closer to finishing an optimization of our engine to fix the frame rate problems some people were having. We’ve dug as deep as we can into the engine and are upgrading quite a few of its core elements to new technologies. We still aren’t quite sure when this will release, but we're working as hard as we can to get it done and tested.

Next is the Fetish DLC. We are adding a lot of new sex positions--there will be more new positions added than we have currently in the entire game. So get ready to experience a lot more different types of sex. On top of some new normal sex positions, we are also adding Creampies, Gangbangs, BDSM, Futa and Gay (both of which you can opt in or out of seeing), and more.

We’re sorry we can’t give you guys dates yet, but we are working to get both of these things out as soon as we can while also making sure we don’t put out a buggy product.

We'll be back soon with more info on the engine update as well as some early screen shots of some of the new sex in the Fetish DLC.

notes.title: New Save Option and Final Mission Balance Changes
notes.notes:
BALANCE CHANGES:
Added a Save Game option to the In Game Menu. Now you can save your game wherever you are. The save points are still in the world, but you don't have to go to them anymore to save your game.

Now in the final mission, there is a halfway save point. Once you make it inside the Needle on the Man Island, you will warp back there even when you leave the Man Island and come back.

BUG FIXES:
Fixed a bug where after beating the game the wrong number of chapter stars appeared in Downtown on the mini-map and in the world.

Fixed a bug where you might stay in the final mission after dying.

Fixed a bug where the In Game Menu was not centered on larger resolution screens.

notes.title: Confirm for going to the Main Menu, Balance Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ccee59a9e6d0efe414685c4863faaf1aad4e77b4.jpg

BALANCE CHANGES:
While in the game, now when you bring the menu up and you press either Main Menu, or Exit Game, you will have to confirm 'Yes,' or 'No.' This will hopefully cause less people accidentally pressing these and loosing their save progress without a confirmation.

A delay has been added in the Jailbreak Competition when you knock out a La Migra agent. So now, when a La Migra agent is knocked out, he will not come back immediately, but in some random span of time.

Ron's Penetration Pound Off got a little easier.

Further decreased the AI's ability to see you when you are invisible in the Spirit Realm.

On high, we doubled the Shadow Resolution for the character shadows. 

BUG FIXES:
The Rubbin' Hood (Hod Chick) achievements will now work.

Fixed minor spelling errors in the text.

notes.title: AI Got Easier, Powermoves Stronger, Bug Fixes and Subtitle Fix Step 1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/ccee59a9e6d0efe414685c4863faaf1aad4e77b4.jpg

BALANCE CHAGES:
-While switching sex positions, the girl's clothes and shoes would come off fairly quickly. They will now stay on for much longer before coming off. The shirt has a 1 in 10 chance of coming off when you switch and the shoes a 1 in 20. So if you want them off, cycle through the positions real quick and they'll come off, but now you can cycle through all the positions and the girl's shirt will most likely not come off immediately, like before.

-The general AI walking around the world was designed to be more on par with the main character, and we've decided to lower this a little, making all the AI move a little slower, think a little longer before attacking, and most importantly, block a whole lot less.

-To also help you dominate the AI a little easier, we've upped the damage output from the Beer Blast, Whiskey Flame, and Lightning Ass Blast powermoves.

-Chapter 8 Part 2 (Boning the Exec Board) - the Normal difficulty level's time limit has been increased by a minute.

BUG FIXES:
-The Cheat codes for becoming Invincible and having Infinite Stamina will now stay on when you leave the level you activated it in (so they will never turn off now).

-There was a bug in the previous balance changes (the one which allowed shrooms to avoid being stunned) that was causing the game to crash at a higher frequency than before. We have found it and fixed it, and apologize for introducing it in the first place. *Slaps Hand* Bad Programmer!

-This patch also introduced the first step of our improvements to subtitles. They've gotten bigger, thicker, and are now yellow. We are working on a Step 2 that will hopefully add a drop shadow and allow for changing the size of the font to an even larger size.

notes.title: Bug Fix and Cinematic Sex Improvement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39893334/b22fa11a88a5f5305f7d700aaa4e328d72a3669f.jpg

BUG FIX:
We were made aware of a bug where people were losing all of their unlocked sex positions. We got to the bottom of it and fixed it. So you should now never lose the sex positions you have unlocked.

NEW FEATURE:
While we were doing this, we decided to also implement an idea that was given to us by someone in the Community. Before now, in cinematic sex you could only do the sex position you had just unlocked, but someone said, "why not all of our unlocked sex positions?" We thought about that, and decided it was a good idea. We couldn't put it everywhere, but where we could, you can now cycle through your unlocked sex positions while having sex with girls at the end of missions.
